hypotheses.justification: `errorConstant P m = 1 + prefixBoundConstant P m + correctionEnergyConstant P m + 2 * OutgoingTail.flattenLength + 4 * TailEnergyBounds.tailConstant`. The proof uses `hP` only to get `hc : 0 < correctionEnergyConstant P m`. All four inequalities only need `0 ≤ correctionEnergyConstant P m`. That holds for every `P`, because `correctionEnergyConstant P m = 104 * OutgoingPulseBounds.correctionJetBound P m 0 ^ 2`, which is nonnegative by `positivity` (or `mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (sq_nonneg _)`). The other facts the proof uses need no hypothesis on `P`: `prefixBoundConstant_pos P m`, `OutgoingTail.flattenLength_pos` and `TailEnergyBounds.tailConstant_pos`. Check each conjunct with p, c, f, t > 0, except c ≥ 0. (1) p ≤ 1+p+c+2f+4t needs c ≥ 0. (2) c ≤ 1+p+c+2f+4t needs p > 0. (3) t/2 ≤ … holds because 4t ≥ t/2 and every other term is ≥ 0. (4) f+2t ≤ … holds since 2f ≥ f and 4t ≥ 2t. So the proof works without `hP` if `hc` is replaced by `hc : 0 ≤ correctionEnergyConstant P m := by unfold correctionEnergyConstant; positivity`, and the same `linarith only` calls still close the goals. `P` itself stays, since the conclusion mentions it.
